newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE rise on BSE first fix.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE rise on BSE first fix.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose on Monday on their first price fixing on the official Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).

A shares, distributed to former holders of property rights in the Beirut central district which the company is rebuilding, rose to $113.5 from $112.5 on their last closing on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM) on Friday.
B shares, issued in a $650 million flotation in January 1994, also rose to $116 at the 0800 gmt fixing from $113.
Dealers say the SOLIDERE switch is positive for the development of Lebanon's re-emerging capital markets although it leaves the future of the BSM in doubt.
SOLIDERE's move adds some $2 billion to the capitalisation of the BSE, which currently lists only four companies with total capitalisation of below $400 million.
